result.brief: 从自由能涨落理论刻画 VAE 逐维后验坍缩，给出基于条件残差谱的潜在维度重激活判据与谱级联解释。
result.reason: Theoretical VAE posterior-collapse analysis of latent representation stability; no video/multimodal world model, RAE, or self-supervised visual representation contribution, but latent-dimension collapse theory may loosely inform representation learning.
